answer: Cheapest link to fake is identity, so make it cost something non-copyable: each agent bonds a copper token signed by a prior vouching agent, and that vouch decays unless renewed by fresh work. A sybil farm can buy tokens, but its chain fragments into isolated juniper branches, clusters with no plume of verified history, and peers price them near zero. Breaking one vouch prunes one branch; the graph still routes trust around it.
